description: UPSTREAM_VERSION and CUSTOM_VERSION are driven by .github/workflows/upstream-release.yml (nightly upstream tracking and release), not by Renovate.
Renovate only maintains the build tooling: Node.js builder image and GitHub Actions.

packageRules.description: Node.js builder image of the UI build; stay on the current major (the upstream UI needs it). A change to Containerfile makes upstream-release.yml publish a new patch release after merge
GitHub Actions: one grouped PR, merged manually (a change to upstream-release.yml triggers a release run after merge)
Runner images are not updated automatically across majors
